title: 10 Secrets Players Found in GTA 6
description:
GTA 6 has been out for three days and players have already found a UFO, Bigfoot, a dog on a jet ski and one mystery nobody can solve. Here are the 10 wildest secrets found so far. No story spoilers.

I did not find these. Players did. Full credit to the creators whose gameplay clips appear in this video. Go watch their full videos:

1. Literal Easter egg (first found by xGarbett): MrDalekJD - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mj_beVHUJE4
2. Cool Dog: GTA Series Videos - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KPmMFfUvslg
3. Skunk Ape: WhizL - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KEZCCpuK0y8
4-5. UFO abduction and alien rescue: Mr Lore - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=veqnSU2DQ_g
6. Belville house: ZacCoxTV - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ylFd8bwNO9U
7. Michael's yacht: Robbin Rams - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fykOLDQ1Xfg
8. Arthur Morgan's hat: MeBashButtons - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_Oiere26wXY
9. Dexter's apartment: Robotic Capybara - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N2NXHEYb0tY
All other footage: Rockstar Games official trailers and gameplay videos.
If one of these clips is yours and you want it changed or removed, comment or message and it will be done.
